pois.name: The Great Pyramid of Giza
pois.description: The oldest and only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World, built as the monumental tomb of Pharaoh Khufu circa 2560 BC.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Sole remaining Wonder of the Ancient World
✓ UNESCO World Heritage Site
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Arrive early morning around opening time to explore the plateau before midday sun and tour coaches.

pois.name: The Great Sphinx of Giza
pois.description: Colossal limestone statue with the body of a lion and the head of a pharaoh, carved directly from bedrock on the Giza Plateau.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic ancient colossal sculpture
✓ Included with Giza Plateau general admission
✓ 4.7★ reviews
pois.tip: View the Sphinx from the adjoining Valley Temple terrace for unobstructed photography angles.

pois.name: The Egyptian Museum (Tahrir Square)
pois.address: Tahrir Square, Downtown Cairo, Cairo Governorate 4272083, Egypt
pois.description: Historic neoclassical museum opened in 1902 housing over 120,000 Pharaonic antiquities, papyri, sarcophagi, and Old Kingdom masterworks.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned neoclassical antiquities museum
✓ Incomparable repository of Old & Middle Kingdom masterpieces
pois.tip: Don't miss the Yuya and Thuya funerary treasures on the second floor.

pois.name: National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)
pois.address: Ein as Seirah, Old Cairo, Cairo Governorate 4241011, Egypt
pois.description: Ultra-modern museum complex tracing Egyptian civilization from prehistoric eras to modern times, home to the Royal Mummies Hall.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Permanent home of the 22 Royal Mummies of Egypt
✓ State-of-the-art interactive curation and lakeside setting
pois.tip: Visit the subterranean Royal Mummies Gallery where photography is strictly prohibited to preserve sacred dignity.

pois.name: Cairo Citadel & Mosque of Muhammad Ali
pois.address: Al Abageyah, El Khalifa, Cairo Governorate 4252360, Egypt
pois.description: Medieval Islamic fortification founded by Saladin in 1176 AD, crowned by the Ottoman alabaster Mosque of Muhammad Ali with panoramic Cairo views.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Medieval fortress overlooking Cairo skyline
✓ Magnificent Ottoman alabaster domes
✓ 4.7★ reviews
pois.tip: Head to the western terrace of Muhammad Ali Mosque for panoramic skyline views of Cairo and the distant Giza pyramids on clear days.

pois.name: Khan el-Khalili Historic Souq
pois.address: El-Gamaleya, El Gamaliya, Cairo Governorate 4331302, Egypt
pois.description: Vibrant 14th-century bazaar labyrinth filled with brass lanterns, spices, perfume essences, silver jewellery, and artisan workshops.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 600-year-old historic bazaar and cultural heart of Islamic Cairo
✓ Free public market exploration
pois.tip: Wander beyond the tourist main street into the metalworkers and spice alleys for authentic artisanal craftsmanship.

pois.name: Al-Azhar Mosque
pois.address: Al-Azhar St, El-Darb El-Ahmar, Cairo Governorate 4292150, Egypt
pois.description: Founded in 970 AD by the Fatimids, one of the oldest active universities and premier centers of Islamic scholarship in the world.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Millennium-old Fatimid architectural masterpiece
✓ Free public heritage entry with serene marble courtyard
pois.tip: Modest attire required: women are provided with complimentary hooded abayas at the visitor entrance.

pois.name: The Hanging Church (Saint Virgin Mary Coptic Church)
pois.address: Kom Ghorab, Old Cairo, Cairo Governorate 4244001, Egypt
pois.description: Famous 3rd-century Coptic basilica built suspended over the Roman Babylon fortress gatehouse, with a timber roof styled like Noah's Ark.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Premier landmark of historic Coptic Cairo
✓ Suspended basilica dating back to Roman era
pois.tip: Admire the 110 historic icons and the intricate cedar and ivory inlaid iconostasis.
nearby: Church of St. Sergius and Bacchus

pois.name: Al-Azhar Park
pois.address: Salah Salem St, Al-Darb Al-Ahmar, Cairo Governorate 4293021, Egypt
pois.description: Award-winning 30-hectare hillside botanical haven created by the Aga Khan Trust, featuring Islamic water gardens and Citadel views.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Green botanical oasis in central Cairo
✓ Sunset vistas over medieval minarets and the Saladin Citadel
pois.tip: Visit in late afternoon to enjoy evening breezes and dine at the hilltop lakeside restaurant.

pois.name: Naguib Mahfouz Cafe
pois.address: 5 El-Sikka El-Gedida, Khan el-Khalili, Cairo Governorate 4331302, Egypt
pois.description: Historic air-conditioned literary cafe nestled in the heart of Khan el-Khalili, named after Egypt's Nobel laureate in literature.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Legendary literary coffeehouse and restaurant in Khan el-Khalili
✓ Traditional mint tea and Egyptian mezze
pois.tip: Try the freshly baked baladi bread, koshari, and Sahlab dessert with nuts.
pois.signature_dish: Egyptian Mint Tea, Mixed Grill & Koshari

provenance.price_status: A la carte dining (No entry ticket)

pois.name: Abou El Sid Restaurant
pois.address: 157 26th of July Corridor, Zamalek, Cairo Governorate 4271101, Egypt
pois.description: Atmospheric Zamalek dining establishment decorated like a 1940s Cairo bourgeois salon, serving classic Egyptian culinary staples.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Renowned Zamalek institution for heritage Egyptian recipes
✓ Authentic Molokhia, stuffed pigeon, and tagines
pois.tip: Order the Molokhia with roasted chicken for the theatrical tableside garlic tasha pouring.

provenance.price_status: A la carte dining (No entry ticket)
